html:
SMTO-KV-0010 — The Agent's scratch notes weren't ready for this Run

GUID: 92a66f65-8536-499a-a850-e421b6059dea
Slug: kv-conversation-required
Domain: KV · Subsystem: kv

What happened

  • The Agent tried to use its scratch notes before SMTO had linked this Run to its Task. Nothing was saved or read.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. If this happened just after SMTO restarted or a Run resumed, wait a moment to see whether the Run continues. After a restart, SMTO links scratch notes only once it confirms which Task owns the Run.
  2. If the Run stopped, open its conversation, check which steps already finished, and send a follow-up asking the Agent to continue the rest. A follow-up in the conversation runs as part of the Task, so its notes are linked again.
  3. If a brand-new request in a conversation also shows this, open Technical details and select Copy error details. That points to a problem inside SMTO rather than anything in your request.

What success looks like

  • The Run's activity shows Saved task scratch data or Read task scratch data without this error.

If it still fails

  • Send the copied error details to the person who manages SMTO. Don't paste a conversation name or ID into your request to force it; SMTO picks where notes belong by itself and ignores that.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Agent KV was called without a runtime-bound task scope: the scope id was empty, or the execution context had no _kv_store or _kv_scope_id.

What this means

  • KV access has no nonempty conversation_id, or capability availability cannot establish a conversation-scoped KV owner. KV checks apply only to the selected conversation. Rejected validation or compare-and-set does not authorize an unconditional replacement; diagnostics do not read or mutate additional stored values.

Why this can happen

  • KV access has no nonempty conversation_id, or capability availability cannot establish a conversation-scoped KV owner.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the calling context and availability reason; a task ID alone is not a conversation scope.

How to fix it

  • The scope is bound by agent_runtime.skills.kv.context.bind from task ownership; src/agent_runtime/native/state.py leaves _kv_scope_id unset until ownership is restored after a resume. Check the run's trace for task ownership resolution and the bind step; the scope never comes from tool arguments.
  • Invoke Agent KV within the intended conversation scope.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • The supported operation receives the intended live conversation identity.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • KV checks apply only to the selected conversation. Rejected validation or compare-and-set does not authorize an unconditional replacement; diagnostics do not read or mutate additional stored values.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
